description: This test file contains unit tests for the UnauthorizedFloodGuard class and the isUnauthorizedRoleError function, verifying their behavior in handling unauthorized flood responses and role error detection.

classes.name: UnauthorizedFloodGuard
classes.description: A class that manages the suppression of repeated unauthorized responses to prevent flooding, with configurable thresholds for closing connections and logging.

methods.name: registerUnauthorized
methods.description: Registers an unauthorized attempt and returns an object indicating whether to close the connection, log the event, and the count of attempts.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counters of the UnauthorizedFloodGuard instance.

methods.name: isUnauthorizedRoleError
methods.description: Function that detects if a given error object corresponds to an unauthorized role error.

ctags.name: guard
ctags.pattern: /^    const guard = new UnauthorizedFloodGuard({ closeAfter: 10, logEvery: 50 });$/

ctags.name: guard
ctags.pattern: /^    const guard = new UnauthorizedFloodGuard({ closeAfter: 2, logEvery: 3 });$/
